$comment: The community feed, as seed rows for posts, assets and the demo users behind them.
EVERY USER HERE IS FAKE. They exist so the feed, the moderation queue and
the profile links have something to render before anyone has posted, and
they are all findable in one query:
select * from users where email like '%@demo.invalid'
which is also how they get deleted. `.invalid` is reserved by RFC 2606 and
can never be registered, so none of these addresses can reach a real inbox
The pictures are picsum stand-ins keyed by `seed`, not real generations, so
the assets carry no storage object and their aspect ratio lives in metadata
rather than in width/height - those columns are pixels, and 16 by 9 is not.
